priceSnapshot.note: Versus the 12:42 COT midday report (75,826): +0.58%. BTC wicked to 75,200 at 18:00 COT, then recovered to 76.3k. No 1H close printed under the 75,558 reduce level, and price is back above the daily EMA200 (76,100). Equities closed the day with a hard sell-off (QQQ -6.4%, VOO -4.4%).

reduceIf.confirmation: A 1H close under 75,200 (today's wick low) opens 74.3k then 73.4k; sell more of the spot core and keep the rest behind the stop.

addIf.confirmation: A 4H close above 77,011 (the 11:00 COT high) would show the 75.2k wick was a sweep and justify adding back.

decisionBox.changed: The midday reduce level (75,558) was tested but never confirmed: the 75,200 wick was bought and the 1H candles closed back near 76.1k. The bounce squeezed about $551k of shorts at 75.6k-76.3k. Bias eases from bearish to range with a bearish tilt, since equities, ETF flows and crowded longs still lean down. The wallet trims 20% of spot into the bounce to cut overnight gap risk.

overnightRisk: Next report is about 02:00 COT. Longs are still crowded (1H long/short account ratio 2.91) and US equities just fell hard (QQQ -6.4%, VOO -4.4%, JPXN -5.1%), though QQQ is +0.65% after hours. Catalysts: Asia open reacting to the Wall Street drop, thin weekend-approach liquidity, and ETF outflows (-$68.8M on Nov 5). A loss of 75,200 puts the estimated 50x long-liquidation zone near 74.8k and the 25x zone near 73.2k within one ATR-sized move. A resting stop at 74,950 is the only protection while nobody is watching.
